short: Realizing Colorful Holographic Mimicry by Metasurfaces
title: Realizing Colorful Holographic Mimicry by Metasurfaces

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: One fixed metasurface should show completely independent holograms as its surrounding medium changes. Phase matrix transformation: a medium-sensitive unit cell lets phase map P1 in air switch to an independent P2 in oil.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/architecture), n5 (DES/variable_sweep), n6 (PRC/forming), n8 (PRC/stimulus), n13 (DES/architecture), n14 (PRC/forming). Premises: The mimic octopus alters its body shape to resemble sea snakes or lionfish according to its circumstances; The iterative Fourier transform algorithm computes the four-level phase profile for a target holographic image; Cedar oil has refractive index n = 1.515 against n = 1 for air

states.title: Structure state
states.head: The written array carries paired gold nanobars whose lengths and widths differ from pixel to pixel, as designed. The colorful sample is a regular lattice of three-bar pixel groups whose bar lengths vary from pixel to pixel

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Both localized surface plasmon resonances red-shift when the surrounding index rises from 1 to 1.515. At 800 nm the index change switches the excited mode from a two-bar coupled mode to a dipole on the right bar alone, giving phases 0 and pi.
states.detail: Absorbed: n9 (PRP/value), n10 (MEC/pathway), n11 (PRP/value). Premises: The iterative Fourier transform algorithm computes the four-level phase profile for a target holographic image

states.title: Performance state
states.head: At the working wavelength the device projects a bird hologram in air and a fish hologram in oil. The same metasurface shows D and C in air and I and U in oil at 710 and 890 nm, so DC changes to IU.
states.detail: Absorbed: n12 (PRF/service_capability), n16 (PRF/service_capability), n17 (PRF/figure_of_merit), n19 (PRF/figure_of_merit). Premises: A phase-only hologram reconstructs its image by diffraction, so the image depends only on the per-pixel phase map; Working efficiency is defined as the integrated hologram intensity divided by the light incident on the sample

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Phase matrix transformation on index-sensitive coupled plasmonic pixels realizes single- and dual-wavelength holographic mimicry on one fixed metasurface

nodes.title: SEM, F3, F5
nodes.head: SEM: rows of paired gold nanobars whose lengths and widths differ from pixel to pixel. SEM: a dense regular lattice of three-bar pixel groups, the narrowest bars only tens of nanometres wide
nodes.solves: The written array carries paired gold nanobars whose lengths and widths differ from pixel to pixel, as designed
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n7, n15 (o3, o7).

nodes.title: MICRO, F3, F5
nodes.head: Optical image: the whole patterned square is continuous, with only faint large-scale contrast. Optical image: the colorful sample's patterned square is unbroken, crossed by concentric interference fringes
nodes.solves: The written array carries paired gold nanobars whose lengths and widths differ from pixel to pixel, as designed
nodes.note: the panel resolves no individual pixel; it shows only that the patterned area is unbroken; the 200 x 200 um size and the 40 um scale-bar value come from the caption the concentric rings are an illumination/imaging artefact, not a structural feature; the 50 um scale-bar value comes from the caption
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown, and n7, n15 keeps shown support from o3, o7.

nodes.title: ATOM, F3
nodes.head: Simulated hologram: a bird in air and a fish in oil from the same phase design
nodes.solves: Per-pixel reflected phase at 800 nm realizes matrix P1 in air and the independent matrix P2 in oil
nodes.note: the medium of each column is given by the panel annotations air and oil; the 800 nm working wavelength is stated only in the caption
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n11 (o5).

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: Reflection dips A and B move from about 0.65 and 0.95 um in air to about 0.80 and 1.25 um in oil
nodes.solves: Both localized surface plasmon resonances red-shift when the surrounding index rises from 1 to 1.515
nodes.note: read off the wavelength axis of the two reflection spectra; at the 800 nm dashed line the reflection is about 0.8 in air and about 0.2 in oil
nodes.detail: o1: Reflection dips A and B move from about 0.65 and 0.95 um in air to about 0.80 and 1.25 um in oil

nodes.title: MICRO, F3, F5

nodes.solves: At the working wavelength the device projects a bird hologram in air and a fish hologram in oil
nodes.note: air/oil and Simulation/Experiment are annotations on the panel; the 800 nm illumination and the 40 um scale bar come from the caption the four conditions are given by the panel annotations air,710nm / air,890nm / oil,710nm / oil,890nm; the letters themselves are read from the pixels
